throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.4988 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX widening/narrowing integer instruction. Measured on LA664 with positive integer operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
